name: IBA International Business Academy
about: IBA is a business academy based at Havneparken in central Kolding, with teaching built around company cases and projects. The BA (Hons) International Business Management listed here is delivered entirely online and awarded by Leeds Beckett University; students can study from any location.

languageOfInstruction.note: The listed first-year BA is taught entirely in English online. Other on-campus and cross-border English routes have separate unresolved intake and application questions.

notes: This page currently lists the confirmed first-year online BA only. It is not an exhaustive 2027 portfolio: the on-campus Coventry BSc has conflicting upper-secondary/AP documentation requirements; Business Management across Europe still publishes 2026 dates; Euro-Asia/AP English-only completion needs confirmation.

The online BA is a Leeds Beckett University award delivered through IBA, entirely online with no required travel to Kolding or Danish student-visa entitlement. Tuition is DKK 155,000 for the whole degree for every citizenship group, plus DKK 750 application fee and service charge unless exempt as an IBA graduate. It has no SU or IBA scholarship.

IB Diploma and DP Course Results entry treatment for this Leeds Beckett route must be confirmed individually. The 24-point IB guidance published for IBA Coventry courses does not establish a threshold for this BA.

The online BA page requires TOEFL iBT 79 with 19 in every section; its application form lists 65. Agree which proof applies before relying on either number. English-medium exemptions are subject to Leeds Beckett regulations.

Predicted-grade format, final IB-results delivery and any separate final-document, reply or offer-acceptance deadline are not published. Applicants still studying provide detailed transcripts and their expected graduation date; arrange final-results handling with IBA before applying.

support.academic: Online BA students use Canvas with asynchronous discussions and webinars; individual student counselling covers study planning, examinations and wellbeing. https://iba.dk/international/online-programmes/bachelor-honours-international-business-management-e-ba/
support.accessibility: IBA offers specialised student counselling for disabilities and additional needs on its international online programmes. https://iba.dk/international/online-programmes/bachelor-honours-international-business-management-e-ba/
